title: Annotated Gemini orbital photo #7: Kitt Peak, Baboquivari Peak and Nogales area, Arizona
description: Black-and-white orbital terrain photograph on a white mount card, marked "#7" with "N" at top. Handwritten labels identify "Kitt Peak", "Baboquivari Peak", "Route 286" and "Nogales", with a dashed "U.S. MEXICO" border line at left. The image shows mountain ranges and desert basins.
